**Supported formats for OCR:** PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, WEBP — **Maximum file size:** 512 MB.  
.zip is not a supported OCR format, so it returns 422 `Invalid file format.`.

[File uploads](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/known-limitations#file-uploads)
